messages:
marie: Postmortem follow-up: capture owners/timelines for vendor outages (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). Please ack if you own an item.

marie: Actions: A) registry auth fallback shim, B) cloud retry/backoff + circuit breaker, C) registry health telemetry + canary, D) quarterly fallover drill.

anya: I'll take A (fallback shim). Plan: adaptor + integration test, PR by Fri.

leo: I'll take B (retry/backoff). Start with conservative backoffs and add a detector to trigger the fallback path. Aim staging next Wed.

anya: note: fallback will default to read-cache mode; adding FEATURE_FLAG and tests.

marie: add token-stretch short-circuit to avoid refresh storms (stretch TTL ~2m) while fallback is active.

leo: will sync with auth team on TTL change and update PD escalation policy for 15m ack SLA.

marie: C assigned to @samir in the doc (will add synthetic canary emitting latency/p99/403-rate + fallback metric). Prototype in dev by EOW.

ops-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket "vendor-dep-mitigation-2026Q2" assigned to marie, anya, leo, samir (due 2026-05-10).

marie: please add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri; I'll compile the tracker and share.

anya: PR: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/43

leo: ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-6012 (includes PR links + timeline).

marie: thanks — if timelines shift ping me. I'll update leadership after the tracker is compiled.
